newsitem.title: POLAND: Swedish Alcro-Beckers may buy Polish paint firm.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Alcro-Beckers may buy Polish paint firm.

text.p: Poland's Securities Commission (KPW) said on Tuesday it had no objection to plans by Swedish firm Alcro-Beckers AB to buy a stake in Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica SA, PAP news agency reported.

"KPW does not object against an intention of Alcro-Beckers, based in Sweden, to buy a stake in Polifarb Debica that would give it more than 50 percent of votes at shareholders' meetings," PAP quoted KPW spokeswoman Beata Stelmach as saying.
Polifarb Debica's 700,000-share initial public offering earlier this year at 65 zlotys per share was oversubscribed.
The company, in which National Investment Fund (NFI) No 11 holds a 33-percent stake, seeks a main market listing on the Warsaw bourse.
